build.description: Build all release targets inside Docker
build.template:
Build the project (release). Here is the output:
!`{ command -v podman &>/dev/null && _c=podman || _c=docker; } && $_c build -q -t raspberry-display . && $_c run --rm -v "$PWD:/code" raspberry-display make 2>&1`

Report any compiler errors or warnings and suggest fixes.
